title: Newmark Completes 157,642-SF Office Lease at Travelers Tower II in Southfield, Michigan
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged a 157,642-square-foot lease at Travelers Tower II, a 13-story Class A office building located in Southfield, Michigan.
